scope: Installed registries, lookup paths, current ORM member changes, and the explicitly listed annotation and relation contexts.
objective: Improve performance and audit dynamic lookup recommendations and current Django ORM support.
implemented: Per-field instance registrations and registry inheritance, without class-name promotion to sibling fields.
Transform expressions retain their own lookup registrations and output-field metadata across chains.
GeneratedField output types, actual primary-key aliases, FK attname lookup restrictions, and composite PK operators.
JSON key/index continuations and name collisions, including constructor and toString keys.
PostgreSQL array indices/slices/length, HStore keys, and range transforms.
Raster band metadata with finite shared descriptors for dynamically generated transform classes.
Transform paths in values, values_list, order_by, and expression contexts; async lookup contexts.
Typed annotation chains and configured Manager.from_queryset annotation methods.
Django 6.1 fetch_mode and BitAnd/BitOr/BitXor expression paths; condition-based constraint fixtures.
Lookup metadata cache invalidation, no 200-name truncation, shared type/transform tables, and cached trie lookups.
Positional aliases containing __, Unicode/numeric lookup contexts, and parameterized array annotations.
Version-aware totally_ordered property and fetch_mode; calendar-version parsing.
Scalar expression outputs for FK/generated columns and preserved source-instance registrations.
Single-valued select_related paths, prefetch accessors, only/defer query aliases, and correct forward ManyToMany direction.
Binding-aware receiver caches, latest annotation overwrite types, Rust cache generations, and retained temporary field identities.
Terminal projection transforms insert a complete value path without an unusable separator.

validation.skippedTests: Two historical/log-dependent checks; application lookup tests passed.
vscodeChecks: instance lookups and dynamic transform continuations
ORM lookup completion, hover, and definition
positional alias insertion and typed hover
annotation overwrite types and projection insertion

checked: Visible gt/gte popup with LookupSample.id__count owner label
Keyboard selection and dismissal without editing the fixture

geoDjango.raster: Real RasterField registry/band transforms; no raster SQL

validation.performanceNote: Synthetic medians: 3000 models, 7 repetitions. Candidate extraction alone is about 5% slower (0.59us versus 0.56us); index building and chained lookup parsing improve substantially.

limits: Registry tests establish lookup availability and path/type resolution, not every backend's SQL support or RHS value validation.
PostgreSQL and raster SQL were not executed. Geometry SQL used SpatiaLite; composite-PK comparison cases used SQLite.
The catalog reflects registries loaded at project startup/reindex, not arbitrary later imports/registrations.
Complex/custom annotation expressions or aliased constructors that cannot be established statically remain advisory; project code is not executed to infer them.
Native desktop popup and keyboard behavior were inspected at one size. No browser/mobile/tablet or comprehensive theme/accessibility audit was performed.
